submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires at the completion token of a highly conventionalized two-token chunk, where the immediately preceding token strongly predicts the peak: title/name completions (The→New, White→House, This→Day), boilerplate pronoun and article phrases (in→our, this→file, visit→us), and code or symbol continuations (namespace/return→{, I→/ in I/O, As→us in Asus). The same peak token after a non-predicting preceding token activates weakly; changes outside the two-token window have no effect.
